# Greeshma R R Portfolio - Modern React Portfolio Website

This is a modern React portfolio website built with cutting-edge frontend technologies.

## Tech Stack
- React 19 with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Framer Motion for animations
- React Three Fiber for 3D graphics
- shadcn/ui components
- React Hook Form with Zod validation
- Recharts for data visualization
- Lottie React for animations

## Project Structure
- `src/components/` - All React components
- `src/lib/` - Utility functions
- `src/index.css` - Global styles and Tailwind imports

## Key Features
- Dark/Light mode toggle
- Responsive design
- 3D animated background
- Interactive project cards
- Contact form with validation
- Skills visualization
- Experience timeline
- Publications section

## Color Palette
- Primary: Indigo (#4F46E5) / Electric Blue (#3B82F6)
- Secondary: Emerald Green (#10B981)
- Accent: Vibrant Pink (#EC4899)
- Background: Dark Slate (#111827) / Light Mode (#F9FAFB)
